# Professional and Lifelong Learning | Harvard University

> Harvard's comprehensive platform for professional development, executive education, and lifelong learning across technology, business, health, and liberal arts disciplines.

PLL offers courses from Harvard's world-renowned schools and centers, including Harvard Medical School, Harvard Business School, and the Kennedy School. The platform features both free and paid courses, with a strong emphasis on emerging fields like AI, data science, and tech ethics, alongside traditional humanities and professional development programs.

## Key Topics

- CS50
- Artificial Intelligence
- Python Programming
- Professional Development
- Executive Education
- Data Science
- Online Learning
- Harvard Medical School
- Business Analytics
- Machine Learning
- Tech Ethics
- Leadership Development
- Healthcare AI
- Free Courses
- Harvard Business School

## Course Catalog & Discovery

- [Professional and Lifelong Learning](https://pll.harvard.edu): Harvard's main hub for professional development and lifelong learning courses
- [Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/catalog): Main course catalog with professional development and executive education offerings

## Technology & Programming

- [Computer Science Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/computer-science): Browse Computer Science courses including CS50, AI, and Machine Learning
- [Programming Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/programming): Browse Programming courses including CS50, Python, and AI fundamentals
- [CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/cs50s-introduction-programming-python): Beginner Python programming course from Harvard's CS50 series
- [CS50's Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/cs50s-introduction-artificial-intelligence-python): Introductory AI and machine learning course from Harvard's CS50 series

## Business & Professional Development

- [Business Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/business): Browse Business courses including AI and executive programs from Harvard
- [Data Science Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/data-science): Browse Data Science courses with analytics and programming tools from Harvard
- [Purpose, Perspective, and Persuasion](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/purpose-perspective-and-persuasion): Leadership course on communication and persuasion by Harvard faculty
- [Building a Winning Mindset: Flexibility and Resiliency at Work](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/building-winning-mindset-flexibility-and-resiliency-work): Professional development course on resilience and mindset with John Cena

## Health & Medicine

- [Health & Medicine Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/health-medicine): Browse Health & Medicine courses from Harvard Medical School

## Liberal Arts & Sciences

- [Humanities Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/humanities): Browse Humanities courses covering history, literature, and political science
- [Science Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/science): Browse Science courses covering genetics, neuroscience, and climate change
- [Mathematics Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/mathematics): Browse Mathematics courses including probability, calculus, and statistics
- [Social Sciences Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/social-sciences): Browse Social Sciences courses from Harvard Kennedy School and initiatives
- [Justice](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/justice): Popular moral and political philosophy course by Michael Sandel

## Specialized Topics

- [Art & Design Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/art-design): Browse Art & Design courses from Harvard University
- [Education & Teaching Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/education-teaching): Browse Education & Teaching courses from Harvard Medical School and centers
- [Theology Courses](https://pll.harvard.edu/subject/theology): Browse Theology courses covering world religions and comparative religion
- [Tech Ethics: Critical Thinking in the Age of Apps, Algorithms, and AI](https://pll.harvard.edu/course/tech-ethics-critical-thinking-age-apps-algorithms-and-ai): Course on tech ethics and AI taught by Michael Sandel with Michael B. Jordan
